hooks.command: DISABLED=$(node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/get-env.js CLAUDE_MEDIA_DISABLED false 2>/dev/null || echo 'false'); AUTO_START=$(node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/get-env.js CLAUDE_MEDIA_AUTO_START true 2>/dev/null || echo 'true'); if [ "$DISABLED" = "false" ] && [ "$AUTO_START" = "true" ]; then media-control play 2>/dev/null || true; fi

DISABLED=$(node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/get-env.js CLAUDE_MEDIA_DISABLED false 2>/dev/null || echo 'false'); AUTO_PAUSE=$(node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/get-env.js CLAUDE_MEDIA_AUTO_PAUSE true 2>/dev/null || echo 'true'); if [ "$DISABLED" = "false" ] && [ "$AUTO_PAUSE" = "true" ]; then media-control pause 2>/dev/null || true; fi
